messages:
maya: Partner-ops reporting small per-device rounding that compounds across fleets (~0.01 units/hr/device), causing ~1-3% monthly overage for large installs.
aj: Can you paste their example event and the invoice line?
maya: Redacted example they sent: `{ acct: "acct_OMEGA", ts: "2026-03-18T09:04:00Z", usage_seconds: 0.48, reported_units: 0.008 }` They claim we billed 0.01 for that event.
suresh: Likely rounding-order + precision loss. We might be converting to minutes or rounding per-row before summing.
oliver: Marketplace schema wants seconds with up to 6 decimals. Partner uses 3. Could be unit/precision mismatch.
aj: I'll run a sim (10k devices) to compare seconds vs minutes and integer vs float aggregation.
suresh: Short-term fix: parse fractional seconds into integer microseconds and aggregate as integers until final billing rounding.
emily: Partner requesting credits if we overbilled. We'll need billing/legal in loop.
partner-bot: Ticket PD-10999 created: "metering precision drift - acct_OMEGA" assigned to @aj (P2).
maya: Acceptance: 1) parser requires explicit time_unit, 2) internals use integer micro-units, 3) backfill + credit calc script, 4) partner schema update + tests. Add dashboard metric: "monthly_precision_drift_by_partner".
aj: I'll own parser PR and backfill. Posting plan to PD-10999 shortly.
maya: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
